verdict.rationale: The vendor's MetalRT engine is described as using Metal 3.1 GPU features on Apple M3/M4 chips, with posted benchmark numbers against uzu: it wins 3 of 4, though uzu was faster on Llama-3.2-3B (222 vs 184 tok/s). The repo also claims acceleration 'by whatever silicon the device has'. The significant caveat is that MetalRT requires M3 or later; M1/M2 machines fall back to llama.cpp, and that path is described only as 'coming soon'. missing for 10: first-party docs in the pack explicitly covering Metal/ARM optimization, native MetalRT support on M1/M2, any evidence of ARM-specific CPU optimizations, and independent hands-on performance corroboration.
